module: "Search" window (fg_search) of the Flowgraph editor: fuzzy search in the current project for nodes, graphs and pins, via editor/util/searchUtil with a "frecency" score stored in mgr.frecency. The prefix 'node:', 'graph:' or 'pin:' restricts the result type. A click (or Enter via the NodeLibrary action map) selects the graph and node and recenters the view. Opened by the uiFindShortcut shortcut of flowgraphEditor.
notes: The results are cached per manager (searchResultsByMgr[mgr.id]) and only recomputed when the text changes (searchChanged).
Keyboard navigation: handleActionMap pushes the 'NodeLibrary' action map when the window has focus, and fgEditor.arrowControllableWindow points to it.

Inconsistencies: findGraphs references a nonexistent global variable `score` (nil); the `match` parameter of findNodes/findGraphs is not used; the sortFun sort function compares typeOrder when the types are identical (so always equal), the actual sort falls back to the score; a pin's info text contains an extra quote ("''").

attach.desc: Stores the manager, forces a new search and creates the manager's result table.

init.desc: Registers the window, creates the text field (128 chars) and the searchUtil search object.

createNode.desc: Called by the editor when the user validates (Enter): requests a click on the selected entry at the next draw.

navigateList.desc: Moves the keyboard selection in the result list.

up.desc: true to move up, false to move down.

drawSearchInput.desc: Draws the "Find:" field, the X button and the help icon (node:/graph:/pin: syntax).

findNodes.desc: Submits to the search each node of the manager (mgr:allNodes()) and each of their pins, with their location and a frecency identifier.

match.desc: Searched text (not used in the function).

findGraphs.desc: Submits to the search each graph of type 'graph' of the manager.

findStuff.desc: If the text has changed, re-runs the full search (nodes + graphs) and stores the results for the current manager.

highlightText.desc: Writes a label, coloring (orange) up to 6 occurrences of the searched text, case-insensitive.

getFilterType.desc: Extracts the type prefix ('node', 'graph', 'pin') from the typed text.

displayResults.desc: Displays the result list (type, highlighted name, location, score in debug mode) or "No Results!".

manageClick.desc: Handles the click on a result: updates the frecency, selects the graph, deselects everything then selects the node/graph and requests recentering (focusSelection/focusContent).

draw.desc: Draws the "Search" window if it is visible.

handleActionMap.desc: When the window has focus, pushes the 'NodeLibrary' action map and registers itself as the arrow-controllable window.

arrowHelper.desc: Counts the buttons of the list, draws the frame of the selected/hovered item and scrolls to keep it visible.
